about_the_game:
“Darkness there, and nothing more.”

- Nykona Sharrowkyn

The best way to start collecting the Shattered Legions! Reforge the Legions that fell on Isstvan V and command them against the Warmaster in the Beta-Garmon expansion with this legendary offer.

Lead your first Shattered Legions deck with this bundle, which includes:

An epic Warlord: Nykona Sharrowkyn, of the Sisypheum’s crew

1 Legendary Shattered Legions crate, with one guaranteed Legendary card for the Shattered Legions

10 Shattered Legions crates, featuring the new cards released in the Beta-Garmon expansion

This bundle offers incredible value and kickstarts your collection with enough cards to build a full deck of Shattered Legions. This is your chance to take vengeance on the Warmaster!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content not appropriate for all ages, including infrequent strong language, depictions of violence and gore, and online interaction between players.
